gloss: criminal side job; illegal job recruited online

definitions.gloss: criminal side job; illegal job recruited online
definitions.explanation: Criminal work, such as collecting money from fraud victims or taking part in robberies, advertised on social media as easy, well-paid part-time work.

examples.japanese: {闇|やみ}バイト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: He ended up applying for a criminal job.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{闇|やみ}バイト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Ads for criminal jobs on social media are increasing.

examples.japanese: 「{高収入|こうしゅうにゅう}」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つられて{闇|やみ}バイト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わり→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧、⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some young people, lured by the promise of high pay, take these jobs and are arrested as the ones who carried out robberies.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧ (dark, illicit) + ⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧ (part-time job). A news word from the early 2020s. Recruiters often collect the applicant's ID and then threaten them, so police campaigns warn young people never to respond.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {闇|やみ}バイト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply for a criminal job
- {闇|やみ}バイト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: recruitment for criminal jobs
- {闇|やみ}バイト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take part in a criminal job

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧: part-time job
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧: phone and remittance fraud
